title: AlNbTiVZr refractory high entropy alloy combining exceptional high-temperature performance and excellent ductility fabricated by laser direct energy deposition
process_description: prepared by laser direct energy deposition with a laser power of 1600 W, a powder feeding rate of 7 g/min, and a scanning speed of 10 mm/s in an argon-protected atmosphere with an oxygen content below 100 ppm.
